text: 近日，自称中国电信原员工的郑季衍在网上实名举报，受到广泛关注。10月6日下午，中国电信股份有限公司大客户事业部在官方公众号“中国电信政企服务”发布贴图称，近期关注到郑季衍相关信息，“郑季衍原为我部门员工，自2023年起无理由旷工635天，期间多次劝说无效”。依据有关规定，于2026年8月31日依法解除与郑季衍的劳动关系。至于郑季衍所提及的工业互联网大数据中心项目，中国电信股份有限公司大客户事业部表示，已于2024年进行过内部专项核查，其言论与事实不符。（界面）
text_en: Recently, Zheng Jiyan, who claims to be a former employee of China Telecom, made a real-name report online, drawing widespread attention. On the afternoon of October 6, the Key Account Business Unit of China Telecom Corporation Limited posted on its official WeChat account "China Telecom Government and Enterprise Services," saying it had recently noted information related to Zheng Jiyan, and that "Zheng Jiyan was formerly an employee of our department and had been absent from work without reason for 635 days since 2023, despite repeated attempts at persuasion during that period proving ineffective." In accordance with relevant regulations, the labor relationship with Zheng Jiyan was lawfully terminated on August 31, 2026. As for the Industrial Internet Big Data Center project mentioned by Zheng Jiyan, the Key Account Business Unit of China Telecom Corporation Limited said it had conducted an internal special review in 2024 and that his statements were inconsistent with the facts. (Jiemian)
